summary: Frontend-only test of the nav restructure, the new Gesprächstraining page (/playbooks), module start and the bonus-tool deep-link. Ran on desktop 1920x800 (free + standard users) and mobile 390x844 (free). All 7 requested features PASS. Found 3 minor leftovers: stale copy, and the free-tier lock logic is inconsistent.

integration_issues.issue: Sidebar.js FREE_TIER_LOCKED still contains '/playbooks' and '/tools'. For free users the desktop sidebar shows Gesprächstraining as locked (nav-locked-playbooks), and clicking it opens the upgrade modal. But on mobile the 'Training' tab (mobile-nav-training) opens /playbooks without a lock, and a direct URL works too. From there the free user can start modules and open /tools?tool=... wizards. Desktop and mobile disagree. Decide whether Gesprächstraining is free or locked and make both match. '/events' in that set is now dead code.

issues: moreHint text still says 'Kurse, Live-Events, dein Profil und die Einstellungen.' (Sidebar.js line 121), but Live-Events was removed
Group label 'Wissen & Community' still mentions Community, which was removed
Subline still lists 'Live-Events · Leader-Diagnose · 1:1-Coaching' even though Events is hidden from the nav

passed_tests: Desktop Training group has exactly 3 children: Gesprächstraining, Challengers, Videoanalyse. Standard user gets the nav-playbooks link, which leads to /playbooks. Free user gets nav-locked-playbooks.
No nav-tools / nav--tools / Werkzeuge / Leitfäden anywhere in the sidebar
nav-community, nav-events and sidebar-changelog-btn are absent, and the Mehr panel has no Community/Events items
Kurse renders as nav-locked-kurse with lock-kurse. Clicking it opens the 'Kurse freischalten' locked modal and the URL stays /dashboard.

/playbooks: gespraechstraining-page has h1 'Gesprächstraining'. main-modules-heading shows exactly 10 modules in the required order. bonus-tools-heading shows exactly 6 tools in the required order. No 'Leader Onboarding', 'Gesprächsvorbereitung' or 'CEO' text.
Gehaltsverhandlung 'Starten' switches to the chat view (1/5) with the welcome message and 'Schritt 1: Marktwert bestimmen'
bonus-tool-decision-maker goes to /tools?tool=decision-maker and the Entscheidungshilfe wizard opens directly at step 1
Mobile: the hero nav shows Dashboard | WladBot | Training | Mehr. Training goes to /playbooks. The Mehr sheet has Challengers and Videoanalyse and no Community, Live-Events, Werkzeuge or Leitfäden.
action_items: Make free-tier gating consistent: either remove '/playbooks' (and '/tools') from FREE_TIER_LOCKED in Sidebar.js, or also lock the mobile Training tab, the direct route and the bonus-tool cards. Remove the dead '/events' entry.
Update the Sidebar moreHint copy (drop 'Live-Events') and rename the 'Wissen & Community' group label
Optional: remove the 'Live-Events' mention from the dashboard 'Deine nächsten Schritte' subline
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.js FREE_TIER_LOCKED is out of sync with the new IA: /playbooks is locked in the desktop sidebar only, MobileHeroNav has no lock logic, and /tools and /events are no longer nav entries

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (3 minor copy/consistency issues)

Close it with [data-testid=tour-close]; setting localStorage leaderos_tour_v1 is not enough. Cookie banner: 'Alle akzeptieren'. The locked-feature modal has no role=dialog, so verify it by its text. Free users see nav-locked-playbooks; standard@wladbot.test/test123 sees nav-playbooks. Module cards have a 'Starten' button inside a card with the h3 title.
